headline: Whirlbite
title: Whirlbite | Hunter's Feast Water DPS | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Whirlbite is a stage three Water Aniimo and a damage dealer, with one hundred twenty two attack. Its ultimate Hunter's Feast has power one hundred sixty seven and puts it straight into Frenzied Assault. Serrated Bite costs twenty energy and adds damage as the target moves. It evolves from Saws at level sixty four with a Wave Stone. Homeland work is Hauling and Water level three. Is Whirlbite your Water carry? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Whirlbite guide: a stage 3 Water damage dealer with a 122 attack stat, Hunter's Feast ultimate and Serrated Bite. Evolves from Saws at level 64 with a Wave Stone. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
